title: CareOps TESL standard-connector Power Automate flow contract

unsupported_sources: mailbox-wide historical backfill without an approved folder inventory and supported connector pagination
source deletion or tombstone discovery when the connector exposes no supported deletion signal
live processing until a supported route can invoke the existing keyed pseudonymization semantics without persisting raw identifiers

actions.source_key_format: keyed lowercase hexadecimal reference without OData metacharacters

concurrency.reason: SharePoint list update does not provide the Dataverse compare-and-swap contract used by the historical design

identity_projection.algorithm: existing hmac-sha256-json-array-v1 with approved key reference
identity_projection.raw_source_ids: transient inputs only; never persist in a List, output file, dead letter or run-manifest payload
identity_projection.native_readiness: no standard-connector invocation of this keyed operation is qualified; stop before live writes until it is

identity_and_retention.source_identity: preserve the existing keyed pseudonymous fact identity
identity_and_retention.deduplication: unique fact_id column plus exact readback after duplicate or uncertain Create item outcomes
identity_and_retention.ordering: timestamp_utc then fact_id; watermark advances only after queue persistence is verified
identity_and_retention.tombstones: retain in the bounded checkpoint/list identity ledger and exclude from replay
identity_and_retention.retention: bounded queue and checkpoint horizon from the approved configuration; do not purge identities before replay and recovery windows expire

failure_policy.unknown_write_outcome: read back by unique fact_id before retry; do not advance watermark until exact row equality is confirmed
failure_policy.checkpoint_write_conflict: stop and reconcile; do not overwrite a newer checkpoint
